cards.card_text: Peter tells the crowd that he and John made the man walk by their own power and godliness.
cards.verse_text: Why do you stare at us as if by our own power or godliness we had made this man walk?
cards.snippet: …do you stare at us as if by our own power or godliness we had made this man walk?

cards.card_text: Paul says to pray for kings and those in authority so that we may lead tranquil and quiet lives in all godliness and dignity.
cards.verse_text: for kings and all those in authority—so that we may lead tranquil and quiet lives in all godliness and dignity.
cards.snippet: …in authority—so that we may lead tranquil and quiet lives in all godliness and dignity.

cards.card_text: He says the mystery of godliness is great, and he lays it out line by line: "He appeared in the flesh, was vindicated by the Spirit, was seen by angels…"
cards.verse_text: By common confession, the mystery of godliness is great: He appeared in the flesh, was vindicated by the Spirit, was seen by angels, was proclaimed among the nations, was believed in throughout the world, was taken up in glory.
cards.snippet: By common confession, the mystery of godliness is great: He appeared in the flesh, was vindicated by the Spirit,…

cards.card_text: Paul says godliness is valuable in every way.
cards.verse_text: For physical exercise is of limited value, but godliness is valuable in every way, holding promise for the present life and for the one to come.
cards.snippet: For physical exercise is of limited value, but godliness is valuable in every way, holding promise for the present life and…

cards.card_text: Paul puts family first: her children and grandchildren must first learn to show godliness to their own family and repay their parents.
cards.verse_text: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they must first learn to show godliness to their own family and repay their parents, for this is pleasing in the sight of God.
cards.snippet: …a widow has children or grandchildren, they must first learn to show godliness to their own family and repay their parents, for this is pleasing…

cards.card_text: Then Paul says these men have their own idea of what godliness is for.
cards.verse_text: These men regard godliness as a means of gain.
cards.snippet: These men regard godliness as a means of gain.

cards.card_text: What do they think godliness is for?
cards.verse_text: These men regard godliness as a means of gain.
cards.snippet: These men regard godliness as a means of gain.

cards.card_text: Paul says, "Of course, godliness with contentment is great gain."
cards.verse_text: Of course, godliness with contentment is great gain.
cards.snippet: Of course, godliness with contentment is great gain.

cards.card_text: Then Paul hands Timothy a list: righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance and gentleness.
cards.verse_text: But you, O man of God, flee from these things and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.
cards.snippet: …you, O man of God, flee from these things and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.

cards.card_text: Righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance and gentleness.
cards.verse_text: But you, O man of God, flee from these things and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.
cards.snippet: …you, O man of God, flee from these things and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.

cards.card_text: Here's the twist: they have a form of godliness, but they deny its power.
cards.verse_text: having a form of godliness but denying its power.
cards.snippet: having a form of godliness but denying its power.

cards.card_text: These people have a form of godliness but deny its power.
cards.verse_text: having a form of godliness but denying its power.
cards.snippet: having a form of godliness but denying its power.

cards.card_text: That truth leads to godliness, and Paul mentions the hope of eternal life, which God promised.
cards.verse_text: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ for the faith of God’s elect and their knowledge of the truth that leads to godliness, in the hope of eternal life, which God, who cannot lie, promised before time began.
cards.snippet: …of God’s elect and their knowledge of the truth that leads to godliness, in the hope of eternal life, which God, who cannot lie, promised…

cards.card_text: Now Peter turns to God's divine power, and what it has given us for life and godliness.
cards.verse_text: His divine power has given us everything we need for life and godliness through the knowledge of Him who called us by His own glory and excellence.
cards.snippet: His divine power has given us everything we need for life and godliness through the knowledge of Him who called us by His own glory…

cards.card_text: How much of what we need for life and godliness has God's divine power given us?
cards.verse_text: His divine power has given us everything we need for life and godliness through the knowledge of Him who called us by His own glory and excellence.
cards.snippet: His divine power has given us everything we need for life and godliness through the knowledge of Him who called us by His own glory…

cards.card_text: And Peter keeps stacking: knowledge, self-control, perseverance, godliness, brotherly kindness and love.
cards.verse_text: For this very reason, make every effort to add to your faith virtue; and to virtue, knowledge; and to knowledge, self-control; and to self-control, perseverance; and to perseverance, godliness; and to godliness, brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness, love.
cards.snippet: …knowledge; and to knowledge, self-control; and to self-control, perseverance; and to perseverance, godliness; and to godliness, brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness, love.
